modified_object: Versioned reusable data-construction operators, prompts, and skills plus separately updated learner weights. Generated ECG examples and data-mixture recipes alone are not the inclusion basis.
feedback: Construction measurement and question-validity failures propose operator/prompt/skill changes; independent regression comparisons use matched signals, requests, seeds, and budgets. Learner feedback and selection score guide SFT branches.
retention: Generator repair records next-round scope and both versions; promoted candidate retains recipe/policy versions for the next round. Skills specify reusable applicability, operator order, parameter ranges, failure handling and question rules.
reason_zh: 正文区分样本/配方与生成器自身的算子、提示及技能版本；后者接受失败反馈修订、在固定回归集验收、跨轮保留。学习器同时SFT，因此按owner最新规则建议 harness/coevolution，不能只因训练权重或产出ECG数据而排除。
version_assessment: Both v1 and v2 contain the same substantive generator-repair and retention protocol; appendix/reference numbering changes do not create or remove Harness eligibility. The selected protocol passages are compared below.
limitations: Scope and protocol audit only; no experiment rerun or full-table numeric recalculation.
The paper describes a versioned generator repair protocol; we have not independently executed or inspected a released run lineage.
Inclusion does not establish that reported task-score gains were caused by generator edits independently of SFT and data mixture.
Source text unchanged for key protocol claims is not a claim of byte-identical paper files.

Repairs record their trigger, changed rule, validation result, and scope. Old and revised versions are compared on matched sources, requests, seeds, and budgets ; adoption requires signal and question checks to pass. Appendices A.2 and A.3 describe the rules and recording protocol; Appendix D provides stage prompts.

Recipes also fix source/edit constraints, replay, and training budgets. Recipe selection changes the data mixture; operator or prompt repair changes ϕ t \phi_{t} . These interventions are tracked separately (Appendix A.1 ).

Each branch retains the same historical training manifest and adds 10,000 previously unused accepted questions , without an extra shared baseline set. All branches use three epochs of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with matched settings; the language model is updated while the vision encoder and multimodal aligner remain frozen. Compare the original and revised versions on the same source signals, requests, random seeds, and attempt budgets, and adopt revisions after independent operator and question regression checks .

Prompt P5 System role. You propose a minimal repair to a failed data-construction component while keeping the acceptance criteria fixed . User inputs. [failed attempt and evidence], [failure codes], [current operator/prompt/skill version], [allowed repair scope], [fixed regression suite], [attempt budget]. Instructions. Map numerical or boundary failures to operator repair; missing morphology to applicability or donor retrieval; ambiguity/leakage to question or context repair; unsupported explanation to response-prompt repair. Specify the exact change and why it addresses the observed failure. Compare old and new versions on the same sources, requests, seeds, and budget. Quarantine or reject when the budget is exhausted . Output fields. Triggering failure; component; exact revision; old/new version; proposer; validation results; acceptance rationale; next-round scope.
